scope: Exploratory learning comparison; fixed before the first training run, not a preregistered thesis experiment
preprocessing: Reuse saved split and 5x6 mapping; fit MinMaxScaler on train only, verify saved extrema; no clipping; float32 input for every model

cnn.selection: Lowest validation cross-entropy; earliest epoch on exact ties; restore selected weights
cnn.augmentation: None; feature identity makes natural-image flips/crops inappropriate here

decision_rule: M when P(M)>0.5, otherwise B; threshold fixed, not tuned
evaluation_policy: Fit all models and select CNN checkpoints using training/validation only before reporting learning-test predictions. No hyperparameter search, best-seed selection, or retuning after test inspection.
seed_summary: Report every run and mean/sample SD for stochastic models. These repeats share one split and are not independent datasets or confidence intervals.
limits: One small dataset and one reused learning split
Different model inductive biases and no matched tuning budget
Not SOM2IMG and not a clinical evaluation
